# Week 11: Files

## Problem Decomposition Context

Some problems read from files. Identify when file I/O is needed. Example: Load data from file → read, process, output.

## Key Concepts Overview

File I/O: reading from files. with open(). Problem decomposition: when files are needed. Combining lists, dicts, files.

## Simple Example Demonstration

Read student data from file, organize by ID. Input (file), Process (read, organize in dict), Output (organized data). with open; for line; split; dict[key] = value.

## Connection to AI Tools

Pythonista2: How read from files? Practice file I/O and dicts.
